visual_action: Singer Gracie Abrams stands at a microphone on a stage, flanked by two other musicians, one playing keyboard and another playing guitar. They are performing in front of a large, cheering crowd at what appears to be a political rally.

cast.name: Gracie Abrams
cast.evidence: On-screen text identifies her as "Gracie Abrams". She is the person speaking throughout the video.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads "Gracie Abrams endorsed Kamala Harris". Abrams' speech is an endorsement of Harris, who she names.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account.

spoken_summary: Gracie Abrams speaks to a crowd, stating that their participation and vote have never been more crucial. She endorses Kamala Harris, saying, "Kamala Harris has spent her life championing the values and issues that we care about. She is the right leader at a very tricky time and we could not be luckier."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Gracie Abrams' speech, with ambient crowd noise and applause audible at the end. There is no musical accompaniment.
editing_pacing: The video uses a single, static shot focused on the speaker. The primary editing effect is the sequential appearance of yellow text on screen, highlighting keywords from the speech as they are spoken.
central_claim: Singer Gracie Abrams endorses Kamala Harris, presenting her as a lifelong champion of important values and the right leader for the country during a challenging time.
intended_effect: To leverage a celebrity endorsement to build support for Kamala Harris and motivate viewers, particularly young people and fans of the artist, to vote for her.
